risk_scenario: Unauthorized access persists after employee or contractor departure
affected_assets_or_processes: Identity lifecycle / source code / cloud / customer data
proposed_treatment: Automated identity disablement where supported; synchronized leaver workflow; revoke sessions, keys, tokens and direct app access; monthly sample of offboarding evidence
suggested_indicator: Time between effective termination and revocation; orphaned accounts; late leaver tickets
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; validate against actual offboarding tests

risk_scenario: Credential phishing or weak recovery compromises a workforce or privileged identity
proposed_treatment: Mandatory MFA; phishing-resistant methods for privileged users; password manager; authentication monitoring; rapid session/token revocation
suggested_indicator: MFA gaps; suspicious sign-ins; recovery events; repeated phishing reports
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; test full account population

risk_scenario: Excessive privilege enables unauthorized production changes or data access
proposed_treatment: Role-based least privilege; independent approval; separate privileged identity; quarterly reviews; just-in-time access where feasible
suggested_indicator: Privileged accounts without owners; stale grants; overdue reviews
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; confirm logs and review completeness

risk_scenario: Confidential customer or company data is shared externally without authorization
affected_assets_or_processes: Google Workspace / Slack / AWS / source repositories
proposed_treatment: Four-class taxonomy; approved storage; data-owner approval; restricted links; expiration; quarterly share review; data minimization
suggested_indicator: Public links; external shares lacking approvals; DLP/secret alerts where available
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; classification must be validated with real data owners

risk_scenario: Secrets committed to a repository or exposed in logs are abused
proposed_treatment: Approved secrets manager; secret scanning; short-lived credentials; owner inventory; rotation/revocation; incident escalation
suggested_indicator: Secret-scanning alerts; long-lived keys; unowned service identities
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; no actual repository scan performed for this scenario

risk_scenario: Security incident is reported late or handled inconsistently
affected_assets_or_processes: All company systems and customer data
proposed_treatment: Clear reporting channels; severity matrix; named Incident Response Lead; evidence checklist; tabletop exercise; after-action reviews
suggested_indicator: Time to acknowledge; incomplete incident records; tabletop gaps
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; response targets require staffing validation

risk_scenario: Endpoint loss or compromise exposes data or valid sessions
proposed_treatment: Managed endpoint inventory; full-disk encryption; screen lock; endpoint protection; patch targets; fast lost-device reporting
suggested_indicator: Unmanaged endpoints; encryption gaps; critical patch aging; lost device reports
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; no device baseline has been measured

risk_scenario: Security logging is incomplete or too short-lived to investigate an incident
affected_assets_or_processes: Google Workspace / Slack / GitHub / AWS / endpoints
proposed_treatment: Inventory log sources; enable supported audit events; define retention; restrict log access; quarterly test and gap tracking
suggested_indicator: Missing log sources; retention gaps; delayed access to evidence
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; real license and retention constraints are unknown

risk_scenario: Third-party or application integration retains excess access or leaks data
affected_assets_or_processes: Approved SaaS integrations / vendor access / OAuth apps
proposed_treatment: Named sponsor, purpose and expiry; minimal permissions; approved service list; monthly vendor access check; revoke unused grants
suggested_indicator: Unknown OAuth grants; inactive vendor identities; access past contract end
scoring_caveat: Target residual only; third-party due diligence is out of scope for this first pack

risk_scenario: No tested recovery path exists for a critical service or data set
affected_assets_or_processes: SaaS service / AWS data stores / business operations
proposed_treatment: Follow-on control gap: define business impact, backup/restore and disaster recovery requirements; assign a recovery owner and test plan
suggested_indicator: Unproven restore success; no RTO/RPO; unowned recovery procedures
scoring_caveat: Intentionally remains high to show policy-pack scope limits; no backup/DR policy included
